Jimi Hendrix - Live in Gothenburg (1970)
Date: September 1, 1970
Venue: Stora Scenen, Liseberg, Gothenburg, Sweden
Source: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=X-onZdJtDVs

(solo)
1. Spanish Castle Magic | waste your time
2. Killing Floor | use my second
3. Hear My Train A-Comin' | train
4. Message To Love
(solo)
5. Hey Baby
6. In From The Storm | just came back
7. Hey Joe
8. Foxy Lady
9. Red House | something's wrong
10. Room Full Of Mirrors
11. Straight Ahead | about the past
12. Purple Haze | excuse me
13. Voodoo Child (Slight Return) | one of these days
